description: This file contains Swift extensions for the CronSettings class, providing various SwiftUI views for displaying and interacting with cron jobs, including job rows, context menus, detail headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view representing a row for a given CronJob, displaying its name, status, and other info.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions for a given CronJob, such as running, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Constructs a detailed header view for a specific CronJob, showing its name, ID, and action buttons.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Creates a detailed card view with various information about a CronJob, including schedule, description, agent, status, and errors.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Displays the run history for a specific CronJob, including refresh functionality and log entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Renders a single run log entry within the run history.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Summarizes the payload associated with a CronJob, including system events and agent turns.
